CapySlides

Talks made with CapySlides

Each talk is a single HTML file: the slides are written as plain text (by hand or by an AI assistant) and laid out by one fixed template, with step-by-step reveals, formulas and interactive animations. Nothing to install: open a talk and present it right here in the browser.
